connections.arrivalConstraint: Hotel check-in arrival, not airport touchdown; include immigration if applicable, baggage claim, transfer schedules, local timezone and buffer.
connections.connectionPenalty: Rank by hotel arrival, elapsed travel time and all-in price; do not exclude useful connections solely for having a stop.
connections.unknownTransferPolicy: Do not claim feasible until ground transport and hotel arrival are verified.

footballEurope.note: Baggage optional; do not assume a checked bag is required for football trips.

airportCatalog.directRouteRequirement: Check nonstop ARN routes on the requested travel dates before suggesting an itinerary; do not assume every candidate has nonstop flights.
airportCatalog.notes: ZRH and GVA included; some airports are speculative nearby alternatives and must be filtered by live route coverage and realistic transfer time.
